import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { FormBuilder, FormGroup, FormArray, Validators } from '@angular/forms'; @Component({ selector: 'app-job-offer', templateUrl: './job-offer.component.html', styleUrls: ['./job-offer.component.scss'] }) export class JobOfferComponent implements OnInit { jobOfferForm!: FormGroup; previewMode = false; saving = false; errorMessage = ''; successMessage = ''; jobDescriptions: any[] = []; // tes fiches de poste selectedJobDescription: any = null; contractTypes = [ { value: 'CDI', label: 'CDI' }, { value: 'CDD', label: 'CDD' }, { value: 'Stage', label: 'Stage' } ]; workModes = [ { value: 'Présentiel', label: 'Présentiel' }, { value: 'Télétravail', label: 'Télétravail' }, { value: 'Hybride', label: 'Hybride' } ]; constructor(private fb: FormBuilder) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.jobOfferForm = this.fb.group({ job_description_id: ['', Validators.required], title: ['', Validators.required], company: ['', Validators.required], location: ['', Validators.required], application_deadline: ['', Validators.required], contract_type: ['CDI', Validators.required], work_mode: ['Présentiel', Validators.required], salary_min: [''], salary_max: [''], description: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(50)]], requirements: this.fb.array([]), benefits: this.fb.array([]) }); } get requirementsArray(): FormArray { return this.jobOfferForm.get('requirements') as FormArray; } get benefitsArray(): FormArray { return this.jobOfferForm.get('benefits') as FormArray; } togglePreview(): void { this.previewMode = !this.previewMode; } onJobDescriptionChange(): void { const jobId = this.jobOfferForm.get('job_description_id')?.value; this.selectedJobDescription = this.jobDescriptions.find(j => j.id === jobId) || null; } getFieldError(field: string): string | null { const control = this.jobOfferForm.get(field); if (control?.touched && control?.errors) { if (control.errors['required']) return 'Champ obligatoire'; if (control.errors['minlength']) return `Minimum ${control.errors['minlength'].requiredLength} caractères`; } return null; } addRequirement(): void { this.requirementsArray.push(this.fb.control('')); } removeRequirement(index: number): void { this.requirementsArray.removeAt(index); } addBenefit(): void { this.benefitsArray.push(this.fb.control('')); } removeBenefit(index: number): void { this.benefitsArray.removeAt(index); } saveDraft(): void { this.saving = true; // logique pour sauvegarder setTimeout(() => this.saving = false, 1000); } publishOffer(): void { this.saving = true; // logique pour publier setTimeout(() => this.saving = false, 1000); } applyLocationSuggestion(location: string): void { this.jobOfferForm.get('location')?.setValue(location); } applySuggestedSalary(): void { const range = this.getSalaryRange(); this.jobOfferForm.patchValue({ salary_min: range.min, salary_max: range.max }); } getSalaryRange(): { min: number, max: number } { return { min: 35000, max: 50000 }; // exemple } getLocationSuggestions(): string[] { return ['Tunis', 'Sfax', 'Télétravail']; } // ✅ Méthodes pour la prévisualisation sécurisée getMissions(): string { if (!this.selectedJobDescription?.missions?.length) return 'N/A'; return this.selectedJobDescription.missions.map((m: any) => m.mission).join(', '); } getSkills(): string { if (!this.selectedJobDescription?.requiredSkills?.length) return 'N/A'; return this.selectedJobDescription.requiredSkills .map((s: any) => s.skill?.name) .filter(Boolean) .join(', '); } }
